purpose: Lesson29–30 continuous bedroom stage matching the Lesson1–2 theatre
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production background asset for Lesson 29–30 of the same children's English storybook as the supplied references. Generate one landscape 3:2 room environment, no characters, no letters or text, no UI, no card border.
Reference 1 is the style and room material reference; reference 2 is the original keepsake that must stay unchanged and provides the blue rumpled bed and warm brown cartoon outline style. Reference 3 is the accepted Lesson 1–2 continuous theatre background, match its inviting hand-painted storybook quality.
Depict an untidy bedroom from an eye-level, shallow frontal perspective, one continuous coherent environment (not a diagram or inset): a wooden entrance door on far left, a fully CLOSED glass window on back wall left of center, a dusty wooden dressing table with oval mirror near left-middle, a wooden bed centered with a rumpled light blue blanket and a clearly visible cream shirt lying on the blanket, and a closed wooden double-door wardrobe against the back wall at right. Small paper scraps on the wooden floor near center-right. The door is slightly ajar as someone has been invited in; keep the window CLOSED. All listed furniture entirely within frame and identifiable.
Composition: furniture and wall occupy upper 65%, large open continuous foreground floor lower 35% reserved for two separately layered standing characters at lower left and right. Leave center floor and furniture unobstructed. Slight depth but not isometric. Warm cream plaster wall, golden wood, muted blue blanket, soft daylight, warm brown outlines, gentle painterly texture and rounded forms. Not a flat line icon, not photorealistic, not heavy dark shading. No extra rooms, no duplicate furniture, no plants covering objects, no people or silhouettes. Full-bleed environment edges, no white padding.
sourceReview: Closed window, ajar door, dusty dressing table, rumpled blue bed with shirt, closed wardrobe and floor scraps visually verified. No prepainted characters or UI text.
